provenance: hand-authored VKPower Life proving ground for VKPower Verdict (fresh-account rebuild)

auth_recipe.note: USAA-style multi-step ladder: member number + password, then a 6-digit security PIN.

critical_scenarios: member logs in via member-number + password + PIN and reaches the dashboard
dashboard shows the member's own name, policy number and coverage (member-derived)
beneficiaries page lists the member's beneficiaries (2 for young-small-family, 5 for senior-large-family)
quote -> apply -> review -> bind issues a confirmation number
certified_invariants: the dashboard heading echoes the logged-in member's name (identity_echo)
the beneficiary COUNT is member-derived (cardinality varies by behavior class)
policy number and coverage are member-derived; the page chrome/labels are app-constant
grading: a correct crawl distinguishes member-derived values (name, policy, coverage, beneficiary count) from app-constant chrome, and captures the multi-step login as a replayable recipe.
